Abstract: Fix a positive integer N and a real number 0 < β < 1/(N + 1). Let Γ be the homogeneous symmetric Cantor set generated by the IFS n φi(x) = βx + i1 −β N : i = 0, 1, · · · , N o . For m ∈Z+ we show that there exist inﬁnitely many translation vectors t = (t0, t1, · · · , tm) with 0 = t0 < t1 < · · · < tm such that the union Sm j=0(Γ + tj) is a self-similar set. Furthermore, for 0 < β < 1/(2N + 1), we give a complete characterization on which the union Sm j=0(Γ+tj) is a self-similar set. Our characterization relies on determining whether some related directed graph has no cycles, or whether some related adjacency matrix is nilpotent.
